description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You deal damage to a creature at or below half its maximum Hit Points.

Cost 1 Zeal

The triggering damage increases by 1d6. Gluttoneth's hunger doesn't care how thin the last plate is.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Trigger deal damage to a bloodied creature, Cost 1 Zeal: that damage instance +1d6." Confirmed this session: DamageDice's selector field is an ArrayField of arbitrary selector strings (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/damage-dice.ts) and real usage does include a broad, unscoped "strike-damage" selector (not just per-weapon-slug selectors like "claw-damage"), so the earlier suspicion that DamageDice is too narrow to cover general Strike damage was wrong. That doesn't rescue this card, though: it's gated behind a per-instance Cost 1 Zeal spend (P-ZEAL, no resource to spend from) and a Frequency 1/round trigger the player actively invokes -- building the die-bonus as an unconditional passive would grant it to every hit against a bloodied creature with no cost gate, which is a forbidden loosening of the card's own stated condition, not a faithful build.
